value.name: MCE (Marin Clean Energy)
value.notes: MCE's own service-area page confirms Danville as one of 16 Contra Costa County communities it serves (alongside Concord, El Cerrito, Hercules, Lafayette, Martinez, Moraga, Oakley, Pinole, Pittsburg, Pleasant Hill, Richmond, San Pablo, San Ramon, Walnut Creek, and unincorporated Contra Costa County). PG&E continues to deliver the power and provide billing/customer service.

value.name: California SGIP - current category and budget check required
value.description: New applications and waitlist applications for ratepayer-funded SGIP budgets closed on December 30, 2025. New AB 209 applications have a June 30, 2028 deadline. The 2026 SGIP rate table publishes $3.10/W for solar and $1.10/Wh for storage in applicable Residential Solar and Storage Equity categories. Household eligibility and live budget availability vary by category and program administrator; check the official Program Metrics tracker before relying on an incentive.
value.eligibility: Eligibility varies by 2026 SGIP budget category, program administrator, property, income/pathway, project rules, and live funding availability.

battery_programs.notes: SGIP program data refreshed on 2026-08-26 from the official 2026 Handbook and live Program Metrics. Earlier locality records contained 2025 opening/availability language. This record does not assert household eligibility, reservation availability, or a guaranteed incentive; current category and program-administrator status must be checked before reliance.

value: Request an inspection by calling (925) 314-3333 or via the online Citizen Self Service (CSS) portal at danville.ca.gov/CSS
Request before 3:00 p.m. for next-business-day inspection; inspections can be scheduled up to 5 days in advance
The following day's 2-hour inspection time windows are posted online after 5:00 p.m.
inspection_steps.notes: This is the Town's general Building Division inspection scheduling process (the same page covers all building permit types, including solar); the Town's page does not describe a separate, solar-specific inspection sequence.

value.program_or_pathway: Standard small residential rooftop solar energy system permitting
other_conditions: Systems must meet applicable health and safety standards imposed by the state, the Town of Danville, and the San Ramon Valley Fire Protection District
